Deliver an approved Nexus backlog.

Read [the Copilot repository instructions](../copilot-instructions.md) and
[the canonical backlog-delivery skill](../../skills/deliver-backlog/SKILL.md) in full. Then read the
specific implementation, review, or merge child skill before each stage. Do not run the Codex model
router. Use the active GitHub Copilot model and available GitHub tools.

Use the target path, epic or issue selector, and flags that I append. Confirm authentication and
current tracker state, resume from the manifest, preserve issue order, and collect executable test
and review evidence. Respect every approval and merge gate; do not infer permission to merge.

Finish with each issue's stage, pull-request state, tests, blockers, and the exact next human action.
